content:
claire (AE): FYI: Parkside Bank wants to lock the POC start but they need compliance artifacts first: SOC2 attestation (they asked for the full PDF under NDA), ISO27001 cert copy, a signed pen-test attestation letter (must list scope + signatory), a sanitized network diagram, and staging IPs/egress ranges. They also want a clear Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta for a 30-day POC with EU residency. Who can own the bundle + presigned upload?

ryan (SE): I can take the bundle and the pricing delta. Quick q: we usually require an NDA before sharing the full SOC2 report. Can we provide an attestation PDF and control summary immediately while NDA is in flight?

emily (Security): Yes. We can send SOC2 attestation and an operational control summary up-front. Full SOC2 PDF goes to the secure dataroom after NDA is signed. Pen-test rules: we provide a signed attestation letter summarizing scope and test date; full vuln findings are not released without redaction and legal review. If customer wants Dedicated in-scope for pen-test that triggers an infra addendum and ~2 week delay. Attestation must be signed by an authorized Security lead.

sue (Legal): NDA + pen-test attestation template available. Note: pen-test attestation cannot be auto-signed; we need a named signatory from our security org and a company stamp. If Parkside requests CVE-level details, we'll need to run the redaction checklist and get legal sign-off.

claire (AE): Parkside asked for a presigned upload to drop their environment diagrams and firewall rule set. Can we create a one-time presigned PUT with 72h expiry, SSE, and block public ACLs? They prefer PUT because it's simpler for them.

ryan (SE): Yes. We usually provision a single PUT presigned URL scoped to their dataroom folder with server-side SSE and expiry 72h. Example curl I send customers:

```
curl -v -X PUT "<PRESIGNED_URL>" -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @diagram.png
```

ryan (SE): I'll provision the dataroom DR-8207 and create the presigned URL once I have the customer's primary contact email and intended filename path. ETA: 2 hours for dataroom + link + short HOWTO. I'll also prepare the Hosted vs Dedicated cost delta (30-day POC pro-rated vs monthly reserved).

emily (Security): For staging IPs we can provide placeholder CIDRs so their infra team can pre-configure: 10.20.100.0/24 and 10.20.101.0/24. Those are placeholders until we map their staging VPC and confirm egress ranges. Also ensure pen-test attestation text explicitly references "inference API endpoints and model serving runtime" if they want that covered.

claire (AE): I'll ask Parkside for the CISO name/title to sign the NDA and pen-test acceptance, and request their staging VPC ID so you can confirm the ingress rules. Also asking whether they insist Dedicated in-scope or just EU region placement for Hosted.

sue (Legal): If they want Dedicated included in pen-test scope, legal needs to review the addendum. Share draft signatory name and we'll prep the NDA + attestation template.

dataroom-bot: Secure dataroom DR-8207 created. Access: claire, ryan, emily. Presigned uploads enabled.

ryan (SE): I'll drop initial artifacts in DR-8207: SOC2 attestation summary (pdf), ISO27001 cert (pdf), sanitized network diagram template (png), ingress CIDR placeholders (txt), and a draft pen-test attestation (unsigned). Once NDA signed I'll upload the full SOC2 PDF and produce the presigned PUT for Parkside.

emily (Security): One more: if Parkside requests vulnerability findings, we only provide high-level remediation summaries by default. Full findings require redaction + legal approval — flag early.

claire (AE): Thanks — I'm pinging the CISO now for signer + NDA ETA. Will report back here as soon as they confirm. :rocket:
